note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after cb8e90f006). RFC 2661 Section 5.8: "If no peer response is detected after several retransmissions, (a recommended default is 5, but SHOULD be configurable), the tunnel and all sessions within MUST be cleared." The leaf l2tp max-retransmit (uint8, 1..255, default 5) is read by ExtractParameters and passes through Subsystem.tunnelDefaults and setMaxRetransmit into reliableConfig, which both tunnel constructors (locateTunnelLocked, handleDial) call; ReliableEngine.Tick tears the tunnel down once attempts exceed it. TestRFC2661ConfiguredMaxRetransmitClearsTunnel uses a budget of 2: the tunnel stays Established through both retransmissions and is Closed, with a StopCCN, on the next deadline. The auditor's overlay mutants of reliableConfig turned it red at the deciding assertions (MaxRetransmit dropped to 0 fails the Closed check; MaxRetransmit-1 fails the Established loop); the stored records use the revert route. Parse and reload are pinned by TestConfig_MaxRetransmit and TestReloadAppliesMaxRetransmit; the startup path reaches tunnelDefaults only through the reload test.
